title: ResolverPlan v1 (capability `resolver-plan` v1.0)
description: A populated, directly-consumable 2-axis execution plan emitted by the resolver-plan skill (= a first-class, populated `context_recipe`). One ResolverPlan per sub-need: CONTENT recipients to READ (where the answer lives) + CAPABILITY recipients to RUN (HITL-gated) to produce the answer, plus governance constraints, goal metrics, primary lens, and an honest no_coverage list. Consumed by deepask and any orchestrator with zero routing of its own. Contract source: .archives/cla/resolver-plan/refs/03-design-decisions.md. The `definitions.resolverPlan` is a single plan; the top level accepts EITHER a single plan OR a batch wrapper { plans: [...] }.

resolverPlanBatch.description: Batch form: the result of planning a list of sub_needs in one call.

plans.description: One ResolverPlan per sub-need, in the order the sub-needs were supplied.

schema_version.description: ResolverPlan schema version. Pinned to 1.0 for v1; bumped on a breaking shape change.

sub_need.description: The sub-question this plan answers (the intent, or one decomposed facet of it).

ia_type_hint.description: OPTIONAL coarse Information-Architecture type hint for the sub-need (A|B|C|D), to help a downstream MECE/completeness check. Session-model selected; omit when not confidently classifiable.

primary_lens.description: OPTIONAL cognitive framing — persona recipient id(s) (e.g. persona/cgo) that frame how to interpret the answer. Session-model selected.

content_axis.description: Recipients to READ — where the answer lives. May be empty (a pure run-to-answer plan) but the key is REQUIRED so consumers can iterate without presence-checks.

capability_axis.description: Recipients to RUN (HITL-gated) to produce the answer. May be empty (a pure read-to-answer plan) but the key is REQUIRED.

governance_constraints.description: Governance recipients a consumer MUST honor before running the capability axis. MUST include page/governance-HITL whenever any capability_axis item is HITL tier B|C|D-Std|D-MAX (a side-effecting capability). May also include bounding metric/* recipients. REQUIRED (empty allowed only when the capability axis is all Tier-A).

goal_metrics.description: metric/* recipients that the sub-need ultimately bears on (the KPIs the answer should move or measure). REQUIRED key; empty allowed when no metric is relevant.

no_coverage.description: HONEST gaps — facets of the sub-need with no resolvable recipient, or a matched recipient that is stale/empty/not-yet-built. REQUIRED key; empty array means full coverage.

recipientId.description: A catalog recipient id: <kind>/<slug>, where <kind> is one of the 16 active recipient kinds.

contentItem.description: One content-axis recipient to READ, carrying the grounding a consumer needs to author a correct concrete read/query.

invoke.description: The exact invocation snippet to READ this recipient (e.g. Read("00-core/pricing-philosophy.md") or an mcp__supabase_ops__query SELECT).

authority.description: Trust class: SoR (Tier-1 / live operating system of record), SoR-external (an external system of record / API), derived-memory (extracted notes / operational memory), scratch (disposable).

freshness.description: How current the source is: static (git-committed), hourly/daily (ETL'd), live (queried at read time), unknown (e.g. wiki last-distilled).

grounding_ref.description: OPTIONAL schema/contract to READ before authoring a concrete query: a migration DDL path, knowledge/kpi-ownership.yaml#<id>, a file path, or null. Lets a consumer ground a SQL/tool call without guessing.

columns_hint.description: OPTIONAL parsed column list (view/metric), so a consumer can author a grounded SELECT without reading the full DDL. Absent (not empty) when the columns could not be safely parsed.

capabilityItem.description: One capability-axis recipient to RUN, tier-tagged so a consumer can auto-run Tier-A and SURFACE (never auto-run) Tier-B+.

invoke.description: The exact invocation snippet to RUN this recipient (e.g. Skill({skill:"cost-report"})).

hitl_tier.description: Blast-radius tier (governance/HITL.md). A = auto-runnable (read/compute/retrieve). B|C|D-Std|D-MAX = side-effecting; SURFACE as a suggestion, never auto-run. Unknown derives conservatively to B upstream.

side_effect.description: What running it does to the world: none (read), write (DB), send (message/email), money (charge/refund), publish (external).

cost_bucket.description: OPTIONAL cost attribution bucket for the run (e.g. gbrain.<role>.<op>), or null when not metered separately.

facet.description: The unresolved facet of the sub-need (what could not be covered).

reason.description: Why it is uncovered: no_match (resolver returned nothing), stale (matched source is outdated), empty (matched source has no data), not_built (the capability/source does not exist yet).

remedy.description: The concrete next step to close the gap (e.g. 'ingest via /wiki sync', 'wire MCP <x>', 'build via /cla propose').
